reply_preview:

1. Go to **https://passwordreset.contoso.local** from any company device.
2. Verify with the **authenticator app** you registered during onboarding.
3. Choose a new password of at least **14 characters**. Reusing your last 10 passwords is blocked.

1. Go to **Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Printers & scanners > Add device**.
2. Select the printer named **PRN-FLOOR3**.
